text.tspan: Nairobi’s premier event venue offers 3,300 m² of column-free space within the Sarit
Centre Phase III expansion. The brief: a multifunctional space able to host
concurrent meetings, yet transform into a single hall. We treated a 7,000-capacity
exhibition room and a 500-seat meeting area with precision-engineered wall panels
